why: LAST YEAR'S EVENT, RE-DATED — the other half of the 28 Oct eight-row set. The museum's own series announcement, posted 2 Oct 2025, prints the whole schedule with the weekday beside every date: 'Tues. Oct. 7  Echo & Explore', 10:30-11:30 a.m. in the Sprouts gallery. Our row says 2026-10-07 10:30, and 7 Oct 2026 is a WEDNESDAY. The cited source is womenspress.com/organizer/minnesota-childrens-museum/, a third-party organizer roundup that now 404s, which is why nothing caught it. Stamped verified 21 Sep 2026. Archived by the pipeline before the 28 Oct takedown, so the one-tap hide never reached it and the event page has gone on serving at HTTP 200 ever since - getEvent filters status <> 'draft', not 'archived'.

Stamped verified 12 Oct 2026 - the pass confirmed a date the organiser's own page contradicts. Archived before the 28 Oct takedown, still serving its event page at HTTP 200.
